Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.scope

Interface Scope

All Known Implementing Classes:
SoftDeletingScope
public interface Scope
A query constraint that applies to every query on a model, as Laravel's Scope.

A scope is applied lazily, on a throwaway copy of the builder, at each terminal call such as get(), count(), update(Map) or toSql(). It may add query clauses only: eager loads, casts (from withCasts or withExists) and row hooks set by a scope would be lost with the copy, so the terminal refuses them with an IllegalStateException naming the scope.

One scope object is shared by every builder and every thread, so it must be stateless or thread safe, pure and cheap (no I/O). It must not run a terminal, toBase(), toSql() or getBindings() on the builder it receives: while the scopes are being applied those see the query only as far as it is scoped so far.

A scope registered without a name is keyed by its class name, so a lambda or an anonymous class needs an explicit name.
